metadata.title: Non-null ruled surfaces and pseudo hyper-dual tangent sphere bundles
metadata.abstract: In this paper, the tangent bundles of hyper-dual pseudo spheres are defined. Then, a new family of non-null ruled surfaces associated with hyper-dual Lorentzian curves is defined via the this http URL hyper-map in Minkowski space and the definitions of the tangent bundles of hyper-dual pseudo spheres. Within this framework, the resulting non-null ruled surfaces are classified. Necessary and sufficient conditions for developability are obtained with their geometric interpretations in terms of hyper-dual Lorentzian curves and arc-length parameters. Moreover, explicit examples are presented to verify the theoretical results.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 通过伪球的 hyper-dual 切丛与 Lorentz 曲线构造一族非零型直纹曲面，分类该构造所得曲面并给出可展性的充要条件及例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 把一类直纹曲面性质编码到带参数的 Lorentz 曲线资料中。
analysis.limitations: 分类限于新定义构造族；摘要中的链接占位未给精确映射定义，不能推断一般直纹曲面的分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 模型与记号较专门，缺少对更广泛几何问题的直接推进。
